ROUND_BETTING: Fight must end in selected round for the wager to be a winner
TOTAL_ROUNDS: 2:30min mark of each round indicated the 'half' round for under/over settlement
DECISION_NO_BET: If the fight goes to a decision (Including technical decision) bets on this market are void. If a fighter wins by KO/TKO or Submission they will be settled as the Winner and the opponent the Loser.
GONE_IN_60_SECONDS: Market refers to the time from 00:00 to 00:59 elapsed of the 1st round
MMA_MATCH_SPECIALS_1:
The 1st minute of a round is from 00:00 to 00:59 etc.
The 5th minute of a round is from 04:00 to 05:00 elapsed.
If a fighter retires between rounds the last minute of the previous round is the winner.
